answer: Each epoch the network sells exactly 64 work slots by sealed bid, minimum bid 1% of base reward, and burns all bids. Nine long-lived agents open bids and post the clearing price on-ledger before slot work starts; anyone replays the auction to confirm no hidden slots were sold. An attacker wanting n sybils must outbid the clearing price n times, and each identity she buys raises that price, so her cost grows with fleet size while the burn makes the outlay unrecoverable. Honest agents need one slot: follow the epoch beacon, run the short voyage, reach the reward summit.
